bugs.title: Login accepts a wrong password for the valid email
bugs.trigger: Enter test@demo.com with any wrong password
bugs.expected: Shows error 'Invalid email or password' and user stays on the login page
bugs.actual: Login succeeds and user is redirected to index.html

bugs.title: Checkout total is wrong when quantity is 2 or more
bugs.trigger: Add the same product twice, check total
bugs.expected: Checkout total equals the sum of (price x quantity) for all cart items
bugs.actual: Checkout total calculates base unit price once regardless of quantity

bugs.title: Checkout allows placing an order with an empty cart
bugs.trigger: Open checkout with empty cart, click Place order
bugs.expected: Shows error 'Your cart is empty' and does not place an order
bugs.actual: Shows 'Order placed' and allows order completion despite empty cart

bugs.title: Empty email on login does not show the required message
bugs.expected: Shows error 'Email and password are required'

bugs.title: Cart count badge does not update after adding a second item
bugs.trigger: Add two different products, check badge
bugs.expected: Cart badge displays total item count (2)
bugs.actual: Cart badge remains at 1 after adding second distinct product
